 4  HN, J  Crlp.No.2132_2024  I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2025  IN/AND  CRIMINAL PETITION NO.2132 of 2024 COMMON ORDER:
1.

The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are arraigned as Accused, in P.R.C.No.4 of 2022 in Crime No.145 of 2021 J.R.Puram Police Station, Srikakulam, for the alleged offences under Sections 376, 417, 354-D, 354, 323, read with Section 34 of the IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. I.A.No.1 of 2025 has been filed seeking to permit the petitioners to file compromise the impugned Criminal Petition No.2132 of 2024, on the file of this Court against P.R.C.No.4 of 2022, on the file of the Judicial Magistrate of I Class, Prohibition and Excise Srikakulam.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners, the learned counsel representing the unofficial respondent No.2, and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing respondent No.1/State are present.
5. Today, when the matter is taken up, petitioners herein/Accused and the 2nd respondent appeared before this Court.
They produced their respective HN, J Crlp.No.2132_2024 Aadhar cards as proof of their identity.
The learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned counsel for the 2nd respondent identified the parties in open Court.

6. Considering that the offences under Sections 376, 417, 354-D, 354, 323, read with Section 34 of the IPC and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act cannot be made applicable against the petitioner Amara Rambabu vs State on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86357282/
3 No.1/Accused No.1.
7.
Considering the same, I.A.Nos.1 and 2 of 2025 and Criminal Petition No.2132 of 2024 are allowed and P.R.C.No.4 of 2022 in Crime No.145 of 2021 J.R.Puram Police Station, Srikakulam is hereby quashed.
8. Accordingly, these Criminal Petitions are allowed.
As a sequel, pending miscellaneous petitions, if any, shall stand closed.
